## Goal
- Execute P0 PRODUCTION RELIABILITY mandate: find the exact Owner AI 503 source and make owner chat survive provider failure/overload/timeouts via a durable persist-first task queue, retries/failover, split health checks, client auto-recovery — then deploy, live-verify the exact 503 scenario recovering automatically, and return one final VERIFIED/FAILED/BLOCKED status with full evidence.

## Constraints & Preferences
- No simulated success; VERIFIED only after the 503 scenario is reproduced, auto-recovered, and completed without losing the owner request
- Durable job model RECEIVED→PERSISTED→QUEUED→RUNNING→(WAITING_APPROVAL)→RETRYING→COMPLETED→VERIFIED; terminal ONLY VERIFIED/FAILED/BLOCKED/CANCELED; one final status, no contradictions
- Retry ONLY transient failures (429/502/503/504, reset, timeout); NEVER retry 400/401/403/invalid input/credentials; idempotency on all writes; no forced message re-entry
- Persist task before execution, return taskId immediately, never hold mobile HTTP open for long work; resume after Render restart; dead-letter + replay
- /health must not report healthy while owner AI route is down (split /health/live|ready|ai|database|queue|provider)
- Phase 6: don't ask for DB credentials by default — audit runtime vars first, report only proven-missing ones
- Authorized repo ONLY ibb142/rork-global-real-estate-invest; GitHub writes via owner endpoint with confirm:true + confirmText:"CONFIRM_IVX_GITHUB_WRITE" (payload nests input:{path,content,contentEncoding:'gzip-base64',message,branch}); exactly one Render deploy per push
- Prior standing rules: no second app; owner Ivan (iperez4242@gmail.com) sole production authority; App Factory FA-01..50 stays PENDING_OWNER_APPROVAL
